file_steps.name: Page Builder
file_steps.prompt:
List the root directory. Read the three files whose names start with
apple-, ball- and cat-. Write one HTML page containing their three jokes,
each under a heading of Apple, Ball and Cat. Use their exact text. Inline
CSS only.

steps.name: Apple Writer
steps.prompt:
Write one short joke about an apple. Output only the joke, nothing
else. Do not look for files or ask questions — answer from your own
knowledge.
